authority: Owner-provided failed diagnostic only; no complete J3 backward or optimizer-step memory bound, 85-percent PASS, training, private identity, FINAL or FBM personality seed authority.
input_classes: owner-provided rank-0.jsonl and rank-1.jsonl plus terminal sha256sum
pinned J3 joint step and trainer source
goal: Distinguish a full-route two-rank reducer correctness failure from memory exhaustion and avoid promoting incomplete telemetry to P43 authority.
procedure: Inspect both rank_started, checkpoint_mode, loaded and rank_failed events; compare rank, source, mixture, trainer digest, checkpoint mode, total VRAM, failure memory and exception; audit repeated DDP forwards before one joint backward; require a versioned whole-step route with equivalence and complete distributed optimization validation before successor GPU qualification.
constraints: Preserve the exact failed evidence root
Do not flip DDP flags or detach counterfactual gradients for a narrow pass
Do not infer backward/optimizer peak from interrupted snapshot
Do not produce personality gold from procedure telemetry
decision_criteria: Both ranks report the same parameter 385 marked ready twice on the first J3 case
17 inspected checkpoint modules all have use_reentrant=false
Both ranks oom=false and zero case_completed
Any future route must preserve all ten families, all four full-fabric views, dynamic J1/J2/J3, checkpoint/resume and 85-percent policy
validation: Owner-provided rank JSONL SHA-256 values as printed by Magnolia; both report Torch 2.7.1+cu118, Accelerate 1.15.0, Transformers 5.17.0, 242697624 trainable parameters, 12778733568 total GPU bytes, 10861923532-byte 85-percent cap, failed-backward peak allocated 5531400704 and reserved 6257901568 bytes; no diagnostic.json printed; remote files not independently read.
failure_or_lesson: An interrupted backward snapshot below the capacity cap cannot qualify full-step gradient or optimizer memory; test distributed reducer correctness before judging hardware adequacy or buying GPU hours.
